newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHIS TO ENTER LATVIA, LITHUANIA LEASING.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHIS TO ENTER LATVIA, LITHUANIA LEASING.

text.p: Uhispank plans to launch leasing subsidiaries in Latvia and Lithuania in the near future, bank vice president Janek Maggi said on Friday.
Maggi added that the bank has held negotiations to start the companies together with partners.
This would be the same as the launch of a leasing subsidiary in St Peterburg, where 75 percent of the company's shares are held by Uhispank and 25 percent by Russian Nova-Rus, he added.
"Uhispank has chosen the strategic position of entering foreign markets via subsidiaries," Maggi said.
The bank also plans to be active in investment banking in Latvia, Lithuania and Russia in order to help its clients in acquisitions, the bank's capital markets dealer Aivo Kangus added.
